method.sampleCounts: 250 clean: 3 cold/warm pairs, 30 search samples per build. Network and stress: 1 cold/warm pair, 10 search samples per case.
method.handler: Synchronous input.dispatchEvent duration, including collection listeners.
method.twoFrames: Elapsed time through two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; a rendering proxy, not field INP or proof of pixel presentation.
method.ready: Navigation until gallery scripts, collection projection (stress fixtures), and two animation frames complete.
method.transfer: Chromium Resource Timing HTML + /assets/ transferSize; excludes thumbnails, iframe HTML, and API traffic. Loopback is uncompressed and does not model Cloudflare compression.
method.coldWarm: Cold browser context then reload in the same context. Baseline/candidate cases run serially.
method.percentiles: P95 uses nearest rank over pooled lab samples; stress percentiles describe ten samples and are not production percentiles.
method.styleExperiment: content-visibility added after load; startup metrics cannot measure its effect.

failedProbeNotes.baseline-reel-1000: Script readiness wait expired (30-second wait, 105.3-second overall case); no valid timing sample.
failedProbeNotes.baseline-3000: Initial inspector response-body cache error; navigation-metadata retry missed readiness; final diagnostic exceeded the 180-second case budget, with no browser errors recorded before cleanup. No valid baseline search timing.
